verdict.rationale: Replicate is an inference platform, so a latency/throughput story applies. The evidence pack contains nothing on time-to-first-token, streaming, latency targets or generation throughput. The only related material is automatic scale-up, managed batching and 'fast booting fine-tunes' mentioned in a billing context. These are adjacent capacity and infrastructure features, not documented low-latency or high-throughput serving.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve latency-sensitive workloads with fast time-to-first-token and high-throughput generation
